pages.title: From Your Computer
pages.text: Open Gallery, select +, then choose From computer.$(br2)Select a PNG, JPG, or JPEG file. The image is stored on the server.

pages.title: From Your Computer
pages.text: Server settings can disable uploads or limit file size and storage.

pages.title: From a URL
pages.text: Open Gallery, select +, then choose From URL.$(br2)Enter a direct image URL and select Load. Private and local network addresses are blocked.

pages.title: From a URL
pages.text: Use a direct public image link.$(br2)The server can disable URL downloads or limit their size.

pages.title: Import Permissions
pages.text: You need control access to change this display.$(br2)Importing does not give other players access to your private image library.

pages.title: Import Permissions
pages.text: A public display can still let permitted viewers see its selected image.
